roles.label: Business Operations Architect
roles.headline: Business Operations Architect | Information Architecture | Operational Governance
roles.summary: Business Operations Architect focused on structuring operational information, aligning business definitions and establishing trusted data foundations across functions. Connects business context, ownership and data architecture to create a coherent source of truth that supports operational decisions and scalable ways of working.

roles.label: Enterprise Architect
roles.headline: Enterprise Architecture | Business Architecture | Information & Data Architecture
roles.summary: Business-focused architect connecting operating models, information architecture, governance and technology enablement. Translates fragmented business domains into coherent structures, shared definitions and reusable foundations, aligning systems and information with how the organisation needs to operate.

roles.label: Digital Transformation Leader
roles.headline: Digital Transformation | Business Systems | Process & Data Enablement
roles.summary: Transformation leader who redesigns the systems behind work, not simply digitises existing tasks. Combines process discovery, information architecture, workflow redesign and practical technology to reduce fragmentation, improve governance and build solutions people adopt.

roles.label: Strategy & Transformation
roles.headline: Strategy & Transformation | Operating Model Design | Decision Intelligence
roles.summary: Strategic transformation practitioner who turns organisational ambiguity into aligned operating structures and decision-ready information. Works across functions to clarify priorities, expose dependencies and design governance and information systems that improve leadership visibility and execution coherence.
